card.name: First word after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word of body text right after a numbered warnings-section heading (such as 5.5 Cholelithiasis), with no line break or punctuation between them. Often the first piece of a drug or class name that begins the paragraph.

modes.label: Drug name opening paragraph
modes.description: The start of a drug or class name that begins the paragraph directly after the heading.

modes.label: Ordinary opening word
modes.description: A common word like In, A, The, Other or Initiate that starts the paragraph after a heading.
modes.example: 5.8 Rhabdomyolysis<< In>> the clinical development program for immediate-release pr

card.plain: It marks the first word of a paragraph that comes straight after a section title in a drug label.
